title: startplasma breaks variable merging between profile.d and environment.d
line: Variables set in environment.d and extended by Plasma's env scripts now keep both parts instead of losing the environment.d value.
explanation: startplasma sources the plasma-workspace/env scripts (which on many distros source /etc/profile.d) in a shell that only has startplasma's own environment, without the systemd user environment loaded from environment.d. A script doing TESTVAR=$TESTVAR:profile therefore started from an empty value, and syncDBusEnvironment() then pushed that result into systemd, overwriting the environment.d value before importSystemdEnvrionment() could read it. The change gives the env scripts' shell the systemd user environment for variables startplasma doesn't already have (skipping shell and session variables), so scripts extend the environment.d values; startplasma's own values, like LANG from the login manager, still win as before.

commits.message:
startkde: source env scripts with the systemd user environment

Variables from environment.d were not passed to the plasma-workspace env
scripts, so a script appending to one replaced its value, and the sync
to systemd then dropped the environment.d part. Fill them in first.

BUG: 491579

media.caption: Master: environment.d sets TESTVAR=:environment, an env script appends :profile; the session and systemd only get :profile
With the fix: the session and systemd get :environment:profile

reviews.text: Clean, targeted fix in `startplasma.cpp` that seeds the `plasma-sourceenv.sh` subprocess environment with non-shell, non-session variables from the systemd user environment that `startplasma` does not already define. This lets `plasma-workspace/env` and `/etc/profile.d` scripts extend `environment.d` variables without losing them during `syncDBusEnvironment()`, while preserving `LANG`/`LC_*` precedence, custom wrapper environments, and clean logout restoration. Verification thoroughly covers both the reported merging bug and locale/logout regressions.
